shortDescription: Corsair Vengeance DDR5 16GB (1 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Module (Solid Black Aluminum Heatspreader / Dual Profile Intel XMP 3.0 & AMD EXPO Compatible / 1.35V / Single Stick UDIMM / 1-Year Local Warran
descriptionHtml:
Corsair Vengeance DDR5 16GB (1 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Module (Solid Black Aluminum Heatspreader / Dual Profile Intel XMP 3.0 & AMD EXPO Compatible / 1.35V / Single Stick UDIMM / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Upgrade your system memory effortlessly with the Corsair Vengeance DDR5 16GB (1x16GB) 6000MHz Single Memory Stick in classic matte black finish, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Ideal for new gaming builds or expanding existing memory capacity, this single DDR5 UDIMM module delivers high frequencies up to 6000MHz with tight CL38 timings at 1.35V. Designed with broad platform flexibility, it integrates pre-configured overclocking profiles for both Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO, allowing simple one-click BIOS tuning on modern motherboards. Engineered with low-profile anodized aluminum heatspreaders in solid black, it ensures superior heat dissipation while maintaining full physical clearance under large CPU air coolers.
